Rapid Attacks II Hit and Run Living Lightning II

- Electrocuting Arrow: Now has an Attack Speed of 110% of base (previously 80%). Now deals 114-250% of Attack Damage (previously 128-281%) at Gem levels 5-20. Projectile now converts 80% of Physical damage to Lightning damage (previously 50%). - Fixed a bug where Electrocuting Arrow was unable to hit enemies that were too short.

- Electrocuting Arrow: No longer a movement Skill. Now shoots an arrow forward that explodes, applying its Electrocuting Rod to all enemies Hit. Now deals 128-281% Attack Damage at Gem levels 5-20 (previously 302-572%). Attack Speed is now 80% of base, and the Mana Cost has been reduced by approximately 40% at all Gem levels.
